question: Under what condition may a wife receive Śāmbhavī initiation from her husband?
premises: Śāmbhavī initiation requires a qualified guru.
A husband may serve as guru.
If the husband is the guru, the wife may receive Śāmbhavī initiation.
inference: A wife receives Śāmbhavī initiation when her husband is indeed her guru.
plain_english: Śāmbhavī initiation is received if the husband is indeed the guru.
